item.title: Eddisons becomes BTG Eddisons under BTG rebrand
item.description: BTG Eddisons will underline the new brand with an extended campaign of activity with Place North encompassing major events and online commentary. The post Eddisons becomes BTG Eddisons under BTG rebrand appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Learning expansion requested for Bridgewater House
item.description: Asset manager Catella APAM has applied for a change of use, meaning the whole 20,000 sq ft fourth floor could be available for educational use at the Manchester office building. The post Learning expansion requested for Bridgewater House appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: How Manchester’s growth is not only good for city region but whole UK
item.description: Manchester and the city region continue to be a key engine of growth for the North and for the UK at large, writes Becca Heron of Manchester City Council. The post How Manchester’s growth is not only good for city region but whole UK appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Artmax gives Manchester office £16.1m price tag
item.description: The Hong Kong-based family office is looking to sell the 53,000 sq ft 10 Chapel Walks. The post Artmax gives Manchester office £16.1m price tag appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Barnfield lined up for Blackburn church redevelopment
item.description: Funding from a range of sources is now in place to reinvent St John the Evangelist church as a business centre, with the £8.9m project set for sign-off. The post Barnfield lined up for Blackburn church redevelopment appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: South Liverpool Homes takes a run at sticky Aigburth site
item.description: The housing association has lodged plans to redevelop a plot in the affluent suburb into 57 one- and two-bedroom flats, the fourth similar proposal to come forward on the site over recent years. The post South Liverpool Homes takes a run at sticky Aigburth site appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Plans emerge for Sale Lido redevelopment
item.description: A 39-flat social housing scheme and a 40-apartment retirement living complex would be constructed on the Washway Road site, which was once a swimming pool and has been vacant since early 2023. The post Plans emerge for Sale Lido redevelopment appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Kellen appoints head of partnerships
item.description: The regional housebuilder has drafted in Laura Moreland, who joins from her previous role as head of land and partnerships at consultancy CPC Project Services. The post Kellen appoints head of partnerships appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Oldham greenlights two Chadderton proposals
item.description: Rowland Homes can deliver 149 homes on a former school site off Butterworth Lane, while hotel accommodation may proceed as the next stage of Ram Mill’s redevelopment. The post Oldham greenlights two Chadderton proposals appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Trio band together to create ‘data centre-ready’ sites
item.description: Paul Boyfield, Gary Goodman, and John Clarke have established TEA Real Estate, which will identify, buy, and de-risk land for data centres to meet growing demand from investors and operators. The post Trio band together to create ‘data centre-ready’ sites appeared first on Place North West.
